label: Sight bands
description: How far a unit sees through the fog of war, measured against the top-down screen. Walls and buildings block sight, and what one unit sees its whole team sees. For source units the band is judged against the game's other units, as speed and cost are.

terms.label: Short
terms.description: Clears the fog only well inside the screen, so the edges of the player's own view stay dark until a teammate sees them.

terms.label: Medium
terms.description: Clears the fog to about the edges of the screen: the player sees what the camera shows. The usual sight.

terms.label: Long
terms.description: Sees past the edge of the screen. The player can't look that far, so the extra reach serves the team: enemies out there show on the minimap and on the screens of teammates nearer to them.
